newsitem.title: USA: PureTec hires adviser to explore strategies.
newsitem.headline: PureTec hires adviser to explore strategies.

text.p: PureTec Corp said Monday that it and its primary operating subsidiary, Plastic Specialties and Technologies, have retained Schroder Wertheim & Co Inc to advise it on a number of strategic issues.

"The company is in the process of considering various strategic and financing initiatives with the goal of enhancing shareholder value and positioning the company for future growth," PureTec said in a statement.
PureTec provides plastic products for the home and garden, medical, packaging and specialty materials industries. It employs about 2,000 people and has 22 manufacturing plants worldwide.
"We have established leading positions in our four market segments, and we are determined to build on these core businesses to develop PureTec's full potential," the company satement said.
PureTec said Schroder Wertheim has acted as its advisor in previous deals and also underwrote a $125 million secured note offering for it in 1993.
